evidence.locator: 2046 x 2046 px; B, V and I with FORS1 on the Very Large Telescope; the page gives a 6.83 arcmin field, centre RA 11 5 46.32, Dec 0 1 52.04 and north 90.0 deg right of vertical. A blind match of the Large JPEG's star peaks to Gaia DR3 agrees: north 90.08 deg right of vertical at 0.2000 arcsec per pixel, centre 166.4526949, -0.0375137 (the recipe's observation); 19 of the 21 Gaia stars in the frame have a star within 4 px, and the galaxy's catalogued centre lands on the nucleus. Found in the ESO image archive search for NGC 3521.
